status: Aggregate expression and retained scalar ownership integrated across scans and adaptive trees; full acceptance remains open
implementation: Aggregate arguments and filters use per-row temporary scopes. Rejected rows do not evaluate their arguments.
MIN/MAX/FIRST/LAST/ANY replace retained state ownership as candidates change; MODE retains each inserted value alongside its admitted key. Numeric state does not acquire payload reservations.

Published aggregate values transfer to the existing window result scope before frame state resets. Adaptive tree leaves retain scalar payloads until tree disposal and published results retain their own ownership.

If optional tree construction exceeds payload headroom after its workspace was admitted, construction rolls back and the scan recomputes the current frame. Other errors propagate; the optional tree is attempted only once.

default.note: Full run before adding the final filter-only regression case and strengthening direct fallback observations; production sources unchanged afterward.

focusedFinal.scope: Seven aggregates across row/run/vector routes; 64 KiB oversized expansion rejection with a retained sibling; replacement and published-result lifetime; direct observation of both tree and fallback reads; filter admission and short-circuiting.

worker.scope: Includes new aggregate-value route on real Parquet via local workerd R2 with shared 64/128 MiB pools.

validation.http: Full default suite includes real Parquet aggregate-value routes over HTTP 206 and ignored-Range 200 responses, row and vector execution.
validation.build: pnpm exec tsc -b passed before cross-package tests and benchmarks
validation.limitations: Coverage, external conformance and clean package installation were not rerun for this change.

performance.assertions: Independent expected values and final zero reservations checked on every benchmark run.
performance.limitations: Local numeric kernels; no cloud latency, VM heap or before/after ownership speedup claim. Buffered report compares admitted and unadmitted modes of the same implementation.

remainingAcceptance: Sort-group and frame-bound planning/evaluation metadata, final collectors and checkpoint serialization/parsing remain incomplete.
Delegated task output ownership, post-write cancellation and full mixed-job/adaptive scheduling acceptance remain open.
Custom reserve-only kernel budgets retain their legacy reservation-only contract; full payload ownership uses MemoryBudget/MemoryScope as public query execution does.
Tracked allocation units are not total VM heap, external backing or production Cloudflare memory certification.
